name: Loam Lurker
respawn: 13-20 s after it falls, from its nest
behaviour: Hides underground as a moving ripple of dirt and tracks the hero. Close in, it marks a 2.6 m circle for one second, then bursts up under it for 15 damage and heavy knockback; a roll or a step away avoids it. It is stunned for 0.9 s on surfacing, bites for 9, then dives again after about six seconds. Cannot be targeted while buried.
look: Squat blocky digger with two shovel claws, a plated back and a ripple of violet dirt when buried.
